detail.longDescription:
Wargh ... one big session to migrate all my docker services from my Synology 718+ to my custom TrueNAS box ... 

Followed advice from a few folks ( @technotim@mastodon.social mainly) but now think I have all my major services set up and accessible via a Caddy reverse proxy (this still need some work) with SSL certs from LetsEncrypt...

Permissions were a bit of a nightmare but things appear to be all working now. 

#selfhosting #homelab #Synology #TrueNASSCALE #docker #Plex #caddy #syncthing #letsencrypt
